end.summary:
Discussed how soil animals help plants and soil.
Pihu identified ants as insects that live in soil.
Pihu connected earthworm tunnels with air and water reaching roots.
The belief that earthworms spoil soil and eat roots remained at the end; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised earthworm tunnels letting air and water into soil, and how soil animals help turn dead leaves into rich soil. Pihu correctly connected tunnels with air and water reaching roots and identified ants living underground. Pihu continued to mix up earthworms with harmful pests and did not correct this by the end. At home, look at a picture of an earthworm and repeat: “Earthworms make tunnels for air and water; they help soil.”
